visual_system: Functional, no-frills clinic site; brand demand does the heavy lifting.
Reviews and login are pushed hard from the homepage.
Limited editorial polish; the build is conversion-first.
site_architecture: Marketing site plus a large app/portal subdomain for patients.
Real location pages for Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth and the Gold Coast.
Small blog and a few info pages; dev and qa subdomains leak into the index.
tone_compliance: Sits in the grey; framing leans product over consultation in places.
Free consultation and pricing language is prominent.
Some surfaces should tighten compliance wording.

steal.note: They cover the five majors; we can go deeper into suburbs.
Their five-city model proves the geo plays. Going deeper is unconfested.

avoid.evidence: Test subdomains rank and dilute trust.
Product-led language sits in front of consultation framing on several pages. Higher CTR, higher regulator risk.
92% of traffic is brand. The non-brand surface is small and easy to displace beneath the brand line.

implications: Dispensed leans on brand and a thin location set, not deep content.
Their suburb-level coverage is shallow, so granular local pages are open to us.
Tidy site hygiene plus stronger education would beat them quickly.

tagline: A big-brand telehealth player riding awareness, not content. Real location coverage on the five majors and a leaky dev / qa surface that needs tightening.

eeat.notes: Strong brand signal, weak hygiene. Dev and qa subdomains rank publicly, schema is shallow, clinician bylines are missing. Compliance framing leans product in places.
